model: u_c = sqrt(sum u_i^2); U = 2 u_c (k = 2, ~95% coverage)

components_documented.u_seed: Type A, SD across 3 initialisations at fixed fold and architecture
components_documented.u_engine: Type A, engine sampling within folds (bootstrap SE scaled by 1/sqrt(n))
components_documented.u_fold: Type A, SD of the five fold-level estimates divided by sqrt(5)
components_documented.u_arch: Type A, SD across five architectures (E11), filled in when E11 closes

note: u_fold dominates at 260 engines; adding engines cannot reduce u_c below the fold term, which is why section 4.2 recommends reporting fold-level estimates
